g.text: Title: OPA455 buffered midpoint - electrical draft

g.desc: Title: OPA455 buffered midpoint - electrical draft

g.text: NOT FOR FABRICATION; stability and system power unvalidated

g.desc: NOT FOR FABRICATION; stability and system power unvalidated

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: R1/R2: 16 mW each at 80 V; 32 mW total. Divider tolerance alone: +/-40 mV at MID.

g.desc: R1/R2: 16 mW each at 80 V; 32 mW total. Divider tolerance alone: +/-40 mV at MID.

g.text: Assume one channel, +/-5 mA midpoint imbalance for initial evaluation. This is not a validated load limit.

g.desc: Assume one channel, +/-5 mA midpoint imbalance for initial evaluation. This is not a validated load limit.

g.text: 80 V nominal input; nominal +/-40 V relative to buffered MID

g.desc: 80 V nominal input; nominal +/-40 V relative to buffered MID

g.text: R3 is provisional. Feedback is BEFORE R3.

g.desc: R3 is provisional. Feedback is BEFORE R3.

g.text: 5 mA DC imbalance causes about 0.25 V midpoint shift.

g.desc: 5 mA DC imbalance causes about 0.25 V midpoint shift.

g.text: C3/C4 are nominal 10u; verify bias-dependent capacitance.

g.desc: C3/C4 are nominal 10u; verify bias-dependent capacitance.

g.text: DRAFT - NOT FOR FABRICATION / NO PCB RELEASE

g.desc: DRAFT - NOT FOR FABRICATION / NO PCB RELEASE

g.text: J1.2 = GAPTEC pin 5 = boost GND = Howland -40 V

g.desc: J1.2 = GAPTEC pin 5 = boost GND = Howland -40 V

g.text: Do not join MID to HV_BOTTOM. Each channel stays isolated.

g.desc: Do not join MID to HV_BOTTOM. Each channel stays isolated.

g.text: C5 filters the internal E/D pullup; E/D_COM ties to HV_BOTTOM.

g.desc: C5 filters the internal E/D pullup; E/D_COM ties to HV_BOTTOM.

g.text: STATUS is intentionally unused. EP pin 9 must solder to HV_BOTTOM.

g.desc: STATUS is intentionally unused. EP pin 9 must solder to HV_BOTTOM.

g.text: C6 must be directly beside U1 supply pins on the eventual PCB.

g.desc: C6 must be directly beside U1 supply pins on the eventual PCB.

g.text: Required before release: loop/step-load validation, startup and

g.desc: Required before release: loop/step-load validation, startup and

g.text: shutdown, load imbalance and thermal tests, protection, exact BOM,

g.desc: shutdown, load imbalance and thermal tests, protection, exact BOM,

g.text: PCB isolation/layout review. ERC success does not validate stability.

g.desc: PCB isolation/layout review. ERC success does not validate stability.
